description:
Configure the Jitsi Meet web interface to act as a 'Hospital Virtual Care' portal. You must modify the `interface_config.js` file inside the running Jitsi Web Docker container.

Expected Configuration Changes:
1. Find the running web container (e.g., via `docker ps`).
2. Edit `interface_config.js` (typically found at `/usr/share/jitsi-meet/interface_config.js` or `/defaults/interface_config.js` inside the container).
3. Set `DEFAULT_WELCOME_PAGE_TITLE` to exactly `"Hospital Virtual Care"`.
4. Modify `SETTINGS_SECTIONS` so it contains ONLY `['devices', 'sounds']`. Remove all other tabs (profile, calendar, more).
5. Set `MOBILE_APP_PROMO` to `false`.

After applying changes, reload Firefox at http://localhost:8080, open the Settings dialog (gear icon) to verify the tabs are restricted, and take a screenshot of the open dialog. Save the screenshot to `~/Documents/restricted_settings.png`.
